answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The zenith is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pulse. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
